Passive.Name: The Gray Cinderella / The Ashen Monster
Passive.Desc:
At the start of each Wave, heal to 50% Max HP if below, and gain The Gray Cinderella passive.
Once per Wave, upon taking lethal damage, negate it and gain damage immunity for the rest of the Scene instead. When this occurs, recover from Stagger and heal 50% of your Max HP, and change The Gray Cinderella status to The Ashen Monster at the start of the next Scene.
At Emotion Level 2+, add 'Triumphant Pulse' to the Personal E.G.O hand. While in The Ashen Monster form, also add 'Dawnlit Ashen Trail: Cinderella Gray' to your E.G.O hand.
Gain 1 Shin (心) - The Gray Cinderella upon: - Healing 25 HP, - Taking 25 HP worth of damage.
Whenever you have 5 Shin (心) - The Gray Cinderella, expend them to gain 1 Mang (望) - The Gray Cinderella (Up to 2).

Passive.Name: Starlight of Kasamatsu
Passive.Desc:
Evade dice gain +1 Power. Your evade dices are retained on clashes against other evade dices. Upon winning a clash with evade dice, deal 3 Fixed Damage to the attacker.
Starting from the third Scene, gain 1 Haste every Scene.
Starting from the fifth Scene, if this character is faster than half of the units on field, gain 3 Haste instead.

Passive.Name: Monster
Passive.Desc:
At the end of the Scene, take 1% max HP damage. This increases by 1.5% per Scene (max of 12% total, additive). Recover 20% of your Max HP whenever defeating a target.
Unlock Craving Monster / Hungry Monster / Starved Monster status when dropping equal or below 80%/60%/40% of your Max HP, checked at the start of each Scene. Whenever healing above the HP thresholds, there is a scene of grace period to prevent getting said status from being reassigned, after which the status will be downgraded to a lower tier. This does not apply when progressing to an higher tier.
Whenever this unit's current HP is above the thresholds relevant to the statuses mentioned above, deal twice as much Rupture damage, but also take Fixed Damage equal to the amount of the target's Rupture stacks. This damage bypasses Shield.
Gain the following benefits, triggerable up to 3 times per Scene each: - Whenever dealing 3+ Rupture damage at once, gain 1 Poise. - Whenever rolling a Critical Hit, inflict 3 Rupture to the target.

Passive.Name: Undying Flame
Passive.Desc:
Upon taking lethal damage, become briefly immune to all forms of damage for the rest of the Scene.
At the start of the following Scene, gain the following benefits: - Recover from Stagger, - Restore all light, - Draw 5 cards, - Gain 6 Haste, - Gain +2 Power and are always guaranteed to Crit, - Losing a clash with offensive dice will instead deal 5 fixed damage or 2% of the target's Max HP as fixed damage, whichever is greater.
At the end of that particular Scene, die.

Passive.Name: Fate Realignment: Champion of Arima Kinen, 1990
Passive.Desc: The Mark of Gluttony is engraved within your soul. May the Three Goddesses bless your foes.

Passive.Name: The Gray Cinderella / The Ashen Monster
Passive.Desc:
At the start of each Act, heal 25% of Max HP and gain The Gray Cinderella/Ashen Monster passive based on the current phase.
Gain 1 Shin (心) - The Gray Cinderella upon: - Dealing 100 Damage, - Losing 250 HP, - Dropping below 50% of Max HP once per Act.
Permanently gain 1 Mang (望) - The Gray Cinderella and change to the Ashen Monster upon reaching 40% of Max HP. HP does not fall below 40% before this occurs.
Permanently gain 1 more Mang (望) - The Gray Cinderella and heal up to 50% of Max HP the first time this unit takes lethal damage.
This character's Undying Flame passive lasts for 2 Scenes instead of 1.

Passive.Name: Indomitable
Passive.Desc:
Take 2 less damage and stagger damage from all sources (Including damage from non-attacks).
Whenever receiving a one-sided attack and the counter queue is empty, there is a chance to respond with [Countermeasures] Evade (4~6) page that gains roll value equal to the current Hunger stage.
Every time this ability is used, inflict 2 Bind on self. Upon losing a clash with that die, gain 1 more Bind, but apply 1 Protection and Stagger Protection to self.

Passive.Desc:
Receive 1 less damage and stagger damage from all sources (Including damage from non-attacks).
Whenever receiving a one-sided attack and the counter queue is empty, there is a chance to respond with [Countermeasures] Evade (4~6) page that gains roll value equal to the current Hunger stage (Twice per Scene).
Every time this ability is used, inflict 2 Bind on self. Upon losing a clash with that die, gain 1 more Bind, but apply 1 Protection and Stagger Protection to self.
